details: Puma with one worker thread instead of Puma's default pool of up to 5. Chosen from 1, 4, 16 and 64 as the least CPU per request on CRuby: 40.1 µs at 1, 45.1 µs at 4, 45.5 µs at 16, 45.8 µs at 64. Ruby runs one thread at a time, so extra threads only add switching.
